name: Monzaemon
main_effect:
When any of your Digimon with the [Ver.1] trait would digivolve into this card, for each of its face-down digivolution cards, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects and gets -4000 DP.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
